# Unicycive Therapeutics to Present at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference


November 23, 2026 7:05am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_5095489204abab78fa148219b1634e28/unicycive/news/2026-11-23_Unicycive_Therapeutics_to_Present_at_the_Piper_131.pdf)


### MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif.


MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. (“Unicycive” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: UNCY), a biotechnology company developing therapies for patients with kidney disease, today announced that Shalabh Gupta, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. ET.


A link to the live and archived webcast may be accessed on the Unicycive website under the Investors section:[Events and Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TKyljrzm0so0xjolc6gsP6Gfzsf6gVN1zKug1O78PM-GRjb_3NQMsyeXX48qWwakfjJL2HweTNq4K65xz0MQ79OetC-Wn_F4GTHNHiIJOi-ozadr3qleluay0qSk7qeue8XupdU1pjDWyPPD-x_4tQ==) .


**About Unicycive Therapeutics**


Unicycive Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing novel treatments for kidney diseases. Unicycive’s lead investigational treatment is oxylanthanum carbonate, a novel phosphate binding agent for the treatment of hyperphosphatemia in patients with chronic kidney disease who are on dialysis. Unicycive’s second investigational treatment UNI-494 is intended for the treatment of conditions related to acute kidney injury. It has been granted orphan drug designation (ODD) by the FDA for the prevention of Delayed Graft Function (DGF) in kidney transplant patients and has completed a Phase 1 dose-ranging safety study in healthy volunteers.
